description: Finished Earth-centered 2D maneuver workbench: choose a circular starting orbit, preview and complete a two-burn Hohmann transfer, apply custom along-track/radial impulses, coast or run time, inspect live orbital elements and a predicted trajectory, and recover through undo/reset. Responsive local canvas/DOM interface with flight record and cumulative delta-v.

numericalModel.units: km, km/s, s; UI custom impulses in m/s
numericalModel.propagator: Universal-variable Kepler f/g propagation, Stumpff functions, bracketed Newton iteration with bisection fallback; small-z series
numericalModel.rootTermination: Absolute universal-equation residual below 1e-8 or anomaly bracket width below 1e-11; max 120 iterations
numericalModel.impact: Forward coasts sample at intervals no longer than 20 s and bisect the first sampled surface crossing for 40 iterations
numericalModel.transfer: Coplanar impulsive Hohmann transfer between circular orbits; automatic stop at arrival; guided sequence requires eccentricity < 0.0001
numericalModel.preview: 320 segments; one bound period capped at seven days, or six hours for unbound trajectories; prediction stops at sampled Earth intersection

assumptionsAndLimitations: Spherical Earth point-mass gravity, planar Earth-centered inertial motion
No atmosphere, drag, Earth rotation, J2/oblateness, third bodies, finite thrust, spacecraft mass, propellant, rendezvous or live data
GEO-height preset is a circular radius; no ground synchronization is modeled
Delta-v is summed impulse magnitude, not fuel consumption
Unusual rapid Earth-crossing trajectories can pass inside and out between the 20-second collision samples
Extreme degenerate/radial or numerical-range trajectories are not comprehensively certified; solver convergence is bounded, not formally proven for all permitted inputs
Orbit preview is sampled and display extent is capped at 100,000 km for current/trajectory fitting; target itself is fitted and distant escaped spacecraft may be cropped
Flight state stays in memory; no persistent storage or export; undo retains the most recent 30 action snapshots
No runtime network calls or remote assets; no WebGL dependency; canvas-unavailable state retains controls/telemetry with an explanatory warning
